verdict.rationale: Fireflies' security page lists a first-party 'Rules Engine' offering 'automation workflows for admins to have control over meeting access and privacy.' That is a native rule-to-action capability, but it appears only as a single marketing line and is scoped to access and privacy. Webhooks and the Zapier connection are developer building blocks or external tools, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of which events can trigger rules, what actions they can take, how users or AI-native workflows define rules beyond admin access/privacy controls, and any hands-on corroboration.
